llms.body:
# Flourish

> Flourish is an easy-to-use data visualization tool built for data communication and storytelling. Create interactive charts, maps, and data-driven stories fast, with reliable and secure publishing for websites, reports and presentations. Used by enterprise organizations, financial institutions, newsrooms and public sector bodies worldwide.

- A data visualization platform built for business storytelling, helping teams turn data into engaging, shareable content
- Support financial and sales reporting, marketing analytics, election coverage, sports analysis, and more
- Bring web content to life with immersive scrollytelling and interactive ways to present text, images, and videos, including interactive SVGs, timelines, and number tickers
- Flourish is part of Canva, supporting integration into design workflows

- How to get started with Flourish:
  - Start with your data or choose from 50+ templates, from familiar line and bar charts to treemaps, heatmaps, animated 3D maps and globes, and Sankey diagrams
  - Create and edit visualizations from Claude, ChatGPT, and other MCP-compatible AI tools using the Flourish Connector
  - Customize your visualizations with animation, interactivity, and layouts such as small multiples (grids of charts) in our no-code web app
  - Publish interactive, responsive, and live-updating visualizations anywhere - including on the web, in Canva and PowerPoint

## Products

- [Data visualization](https://flourish.studio/product/data-visualization/): Create interactive charts and maps using no-code templates
- [Flourish stories](https://flourish.studio/product/data-storytelling/): Build multi-step, scrollytelling stories combining charts and narrative
- [Interactive content](https://flourish.studio/product/interactive-content/): Visualize text, images and audio with interactive templates including timelines, countdowns and quizzes
- [Flourish Assistant](https://flourish.studio/product/ai-assistant/): AI-powered guidance to refine visualizations using plain-language prompts, inside the Flourish editor
- [Flourish Connector](https://flourish.studio/product/mcp-connector/): Connect Flourish to Claude, ChatGPT and other MCP-compatible AI tools to create and edit visualizations from your own workflow
- [PowerPoint integration](https://flourish.studio/integrations/powerpoint/): Build charts in Flourish and present them live in PowerPoint – interactive, animated and updated instantly

## Solutions

- [Financial services](https://flourish.studio/solutions/financial-services/): Interactive, on-brand financial data visualization for reports, client communications and analysis
- [Professional services](https://flourish.studio/solutions/professional-services/): Customizable visuals and collaboration for consultancies and advisory teams
- [Marketing](https://flourish.studio/solutions/marketing/): On-brand visual stories from marketing and campaign data
- [Newsrooms](https://flourish.studio/solutions/newsrooms/): Fast, interactive visuals for journalists and news organizations
- [Government](https://flourish.studio/solutions/government/): Data stories that support transparency and public understanding
- [Education](https://flourish.studio/solutions/education/): Data visualization and storytelling for teaching, research and communications
- [Nonprofits](https://flourish.studio/solutions/not-for-profit/): Impactful, interactive visuals for nonprofit reporting and campaigns
- [Pricing](https://flourish.studio/pricing/): Plans from free to enterprise, including API access and white-label options

## Chart guides

- [Chart guides overview](https://flourish.studio/visualisations/): Full index of Flourish chart types with usage guidance and examples
- [Bar charts](https://flourish.studio/visualisations/bar-charts/): Interactive bar, column, stacked, diverging and waterfall charts
- [Line charts](https://flourish.studio/visualisations/line-charts/): Trend lines, multi-series comparisons, forecasts and animated line chart races
- [Line, bar and pie charts](https://flourish.studio/visualisations/line-bar-pie-charts/): Switchable chart types in a single flexible template
- [Area charts](https://flourish.studio/visualisations/area-charts/): Show volume and trends over time, stacked or unstacked
- [Maps](https://flourish.studio/visualisations/maps/): Interactive choropleth, proportional symbol, and projection maps
- [Scrollytelling](https://flourish.studio/visualisations/scrollytelling/): Scroll-triggered data stories combining charts, maps and narrative
- [Network charts](https://flourish.studio/visualisations/network-charts/): Visualize relationships, hierarchies and flows between entities
- [How to choose the right chart type](https://flourish.studio/blog/choosing-the-right-visualisation/): A guide to matching your data and story to the right visualization format

## Examples

- [Examples gallery](https://flourish.studio/examples/): 400+ real-world visualizations built with Flourish, browsable by industry and use case

## Additional resources

- [Master data storytelling](https://flourish.studio/learn/master-data-storytelling/): A five-step framework for data storytelling – narrative, chart type, data, color and text – with examples
- [AI-powered workflows](https://flourish.studio/usecases/ai-workflows/): Step-by-step guides for turning prompts into published visualizations with the Flourish Assistant and Connector
- [Help docs](https://helpcenter.flourish.studio/hc/en-us): Full documentation for using Flourish templates and features
- [For developers](https://developers.flourish.studio/): Flourish SDK and API for building custom templates and data integrations
- [About us](https://flourish.studio/company/): Background on Flourish and its acquisition by Canva in 2022
- [FAQs](https://flourish.studio/resources/faq/): Common questions about Flourish's features, pricing and use cases

## Last updated

October 22, 2026

Where data meets storytelling

Create stunning charts, maps and interactive content that engage and inspire – instantly. No coding required.

Get started now Talk to us

Trusted by leaders worldwide to reach audiences of millions every day

Turn data into stories worth sharing

From data visualizations and interactive elements to immersive storytelling, Flourish empowers you to turn complex data into interactive visuals that wow your audience - whether you're an expert or just starting out.

Browse examples

Your data, fully interactive

Transform raw data into interactive visualizations that are as sleek as they are engaging. Say goodbye to static charts and let your audience explore, connect, and truly understand your story.

No-code creation, stunning results

Create professional-grade visuals in minutes — no coding, no hassle. Simply import your data and transform it into interactive visuals that grab attention. It's as easy as it gets.

Share anywhere, look great everywhere

Seamlessly share and embed your visualisations across platforms—websites, presentations, social media assets and more. Watch them adapt beautifully to any screen, captivating audiences across all devices.

Team up, stay on brand

Simplify collaboration and ensure your visuals stay polished and on-brand. Advanced sharing and customization options let your team create with confidence.

Create faster with AI, stay in control

Start in your AI tool with the Connector, then refine in Flourish with the Assistant. Get from data to polished, interactive visual faster — with every change still in your hands.

Flourish for

    Used by thousands of companies every day, including:

    Flourish support is great: accessible, friendly, pursuing solutions for our eternal ‘exception of the rules’ queries to make visualizations work in our 40 languages.”

    Roberto Belo-Rovella
    Editor, BBC World Service

    We live and breathe data, and no tool has enabled us to bring our data to life in a beautiful way better than Flourish has. It's a game changer.”

    Joel Leeman
    Sr. Executive Producer, London Stock Exchange

    Let’s connect

    Ready to transform your work with data storytelling? Connect with our team to learn more and get started today!

    Get in touch

    Flourish is a powerful data visualization platform that empowers the world to tell stories with data. Trusted by organizations and newsrooms worldwide, Flourish helps creators bring data narratives to life with highly engaging, interactive and impressive visualizations. Our extensive library of templates and seamless embedding options make every data story informative and truly captivating.

    Flourish was co-founded in 2018 by Duncan Clark and Robin Houston. Duncan has a background in data journalism and publishing, while Robin is a mathematician and developer. In 2022, Canva acquired Flourish with the shared goal of democratizing data storytelling and making data visualization accessible to all. Read more about this here.

    Flourish combines a wide range of visualizations with tools for clear data communication, helping teams create engaging, on-brand content quickly and efficiently.

    • Start where you already work: Create through compatible AI tools with the Flourish Connector (MCP), connect workflows through the API, or start directly in the web app with your data or a template.
    • A wide range of visuals: Choose from 50+ templates, from bar charts and interactive maps to Sankey diagrams, data explorers, and interactive timelines.
    • A clear data narrative: Use annotations, animation, filters and time sliders, multi-step narratives, or scrollytelling to guide audiences through key findings while letting them explore your data. The AI-powered Assistant helps you refine your visuals using plain-language requests.
    • Interactivity where your audience is: Easily embed responsive, interactive visuals on websites and in digital publications, or keep them animated and interactive in Canva and PowerPoint.
    • Consistent design and repeatable workflows: Apply shared brand themes, keep content updated with live data, and access collaboration and publishing tools on paid plans.
    • Security and trust: Flourish is ISO 27001-certified, with security and governance features such as single sign-on, role-based permissions, and publishing approval workflows to support organizational requirements.

    Flourish works alongside your BI tools, specializing in communicating your findings through interactive data visualization and storytelling. Its templates and API support data exploration and dashboard integration, while its storytelling features help you turn insights into interactive visualizations with a clear narrative, ready to add to presentations, digital publications, and websites.
